posts.title: Staging Cabinet
posts.description: Not a storage cabinet, but a staging cabinet. The shelves have a lip on the front and strip on the back to prevent cars - in their boxes* - from sliding off. The front shelf trim also provides a finished look that matches the style of the cabinet itself. This feature wasn't part of the original design but came about during reconstruction.
